summary: SS Innovations International, Inc. (Nasdaq: SSII; non-U.S. incorporation and reporting obligations) filed a Form 8-K on October 9, 2026, reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor and the issuance of a secured convertible promissory note. The note has an original principal amount of $21,025,000, issued for $20,000,000, implying $1,000,000 original issue discount and $25,000 in investor expenses. The note bears 8.75% annual interest, compounds daily, matures in 36 months, and is secured by intellectual property held by SSI IP Holdings. The company filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b) to its Form S-3 shelf registration.
